reason: Use Tier 2: separate next-item prediction from auxiliary masked reconstruction within one jointly trained network. Bidirectional reconstruction reached 0.5800, while local convolution and cosine scoring reduced performance, favoring preservation of the reference representation and dot-product head. A remaining hypothesis is that auxiliary corruption removes useful context from the final query during training, creating a mismatch with inference.

plan.data_processing_and_feature_engineering: Modify MaskedHistories to return two aligned views of the same sampled training prefix: a prediction view with only the final target masked, and an auxiliary view retaining the reference historical masking strategy. This isolates context corruption as the experimental factor while preserving prefix selection, user coverage, MAXLEN, item identifiers, supplied splits, and seed settings. Preserve prediction_sequence(history, itemnum, maxlen), existing sequence and labels names, and Dataset entry points; add explicitly named auxiliary tensors without exposing hidden labels to model inputs.
plan.training_evaluation: Restore the reference MaskedSASRec without convolution adapters or cosine normalization, retaining its tied dot-product head and jointly trained item_bias. Change the objective to 0.5 times final-position sampled-softmax loss from the prediction view plus 0.5 times historical reconstruction loss from the auxiliary view, using the same network parameters and shared 256 sampled negatives; use final-position loss alone when no auxiliary targets exist. Preserve optimizer settings, epoch limit, patience, checkpoint selection, train_one, evaluate, and write_predict_script, and export exactly one selected checkpoint per category using the unchanged prediction-only forward path. Verify that final-query inputs equal prediction_sequence for the corresponding prefix and that exported scores match the selected model, retaining fixed validation users and candidates, all four routes, DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], trial-local artifacts, and single-GPU execution. Print the selected checkpoints' measured macro HR@10 as the final log line, treating host evaluation as authoritative and leaving hidden-test inference to the host.
